events.did: groaned and dragged his head up, then discovered he was sitting upright on a metal bench
events.quote_anchor: His wrists were locked together in front of him with heavy-duty cuffs, and his upper half was pinned to the wall behind him

events.did: tried to lunge forward when the night of the motel slammed back into him, but the straps held firm
events.quote_anchor: The motel. The agents. Syd. All at once, Mitch tried to lunge forward, but the straps held firm, and pain erupted down his side.

events.did: recalled his broken ribs and the darts that had slammed into his sternum
events.quote_anchor: Right. Stairs. Ribs. Broken. The center of his chest ached, too, where the darts had slammed into his sternum.

events.did: sagged back in the restraints and looked around at the low ceiling and the metal lattice
events.quote_anchor: The ceiling was too low to stand upright, even if he hadn’t been tied down. The walls and floor were covered in a metal lattice

events.did: reached the hidden compartment in the heel of his boot and ejected the small flat blade
events.quote_anchor: he got his left boot close enough to reach the hidden compartment in the heel and eject the small flat blade

events.did: sawed through the straps until he was free, with bleeding fingers, sweat and dizziness
events.quote_anchor: By the time he got free, minutes—or hours—later his fingers were bleeding, and he was sweating, and dizzy.

events.did: twisted the cuffs until he found a groove in the metal and maneuvered the blade into the nearest gap
events.quote_anchor: He maneuvered the tip of the blade to the nearest gap and—

events.did: was shocked by the cuffs and then gritted his teeth to try again
events.quote_anchor: Of course they’d been equipped with a deterrent.

relations.did: learned from Victor Vale that pain was just a sensation and the mind decided what it meant
relations.quote_anchor: Besides, if Victor Vale had taught him anything, it was that pain was just a sensation. The body felt it. The mind decided what it meant.

relations.did: was locked inside a metal box while Syd was out there somewhere on her own
relations.quote_anchor: when he was locked inside a metal box and Syd was out there somewhere on her own

relations.did: was given a handle of vodka by a friend at sixteen to dull the pain after a brutal fight
relations.quote_anchor: Once, when he was sixteen, after a brutal fight, a friend had given him a handle of vodka, saying it would dull the pain.

relations.did: was still carrying in his system whatever they had shot him with
relations.quote_anchor: Whatever they’d shot him with was clearly still in his system.

numbers.quote_anchor: after a solid minute of sawing, the first strap finally broke, giving him leverage to attack the next

numbers.did: wondered how long he had been out, whether an hour or a day
numbers.quote_anchor: Mitch rolled his neck and groaned. How long had he been out? An hour? A day?

numbers.did: had a single set of doors with no handle on the inside and only a small digital panel
numbers.quote_anchor: there was a single set of doors, with no handle on the inside, only a small digital panel
